title: Installation Jobs: Contract Valuation Bands for Permit Filings
content:
**Contract valuation bands for permit filings — Installation Jobs**

The permit administration fee of a permitted **Installation Jobs** record carries a valuation adder that follows the price of the contract the job installs — the contract price on the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract for a window job, or on the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract for a door job. The adder is added to the fee.

| Contract price | Valuation adder |
|---|---|
| above $25,000.00 (25000 USD) | $60.00 |
| above $15,000.00 (15000 USD) up to $25,000.00 | $30.00 |
| $15,000.00 or less | nothing |

## Band boundaries (hypothetical prices)

| Contract price | Adder |
|---|---|
| 25,000.01 | 60.00 |
| 25,000.00 | 30.00 |
| 15,000.01 | 30.00 |
| 15,000.00 | nothing |

## Points of the schedule

- The price that decides the band is the price of the contract the job installs, as the contract record shows it.
- A price exactly at a band edge stays in the lower band: $25,000.00 takes $30.00, and $15,000.00 takes nothing.
